presentation.description:
You see that there is no winning the situation and are able to execute a more effective retreat to save your people.

DAILY / MINOR

Personal

Effect: You or an ally must lose 1 healing surge. The DM interrupts the combat encounter with a skill challenge. The skill challenge is created with the players; together you all decide its goal. The negative consequence for losing is generally just resuming the combat, though often in a different place farther away from the initial battle, depending on how many successful checks the party got before they failed the skill challenge. The difficulty of the skill challenge is dependent on the difference in level between the players and the enemies; the DCs of the checks themselves are dependent on the level of the highest enemy. The players escape far enough away to take a short rest if they succeed. The DM is free to adjust the difficulty of the skill challenge depending on other enemy factors as well. Close Burst 10

Personal

You cannot use this power on any ritual that creates or enchants an item, su ch as Brew Potion or Enchant Magic Item.

presentation.description:
The room stands up all at once and waits to be told what it is fo

DAILY / STANDARD

Close Burst 20

Target: Up to 10 nonmagical objects within the burst that are not fastened down or held by a creature. Medium objects count as two, Large objects count as four, and Huge objects count as eight. You cannot animate Huge or larger objects.

Effect: Each target animates until the end of your next turn, hovering above the ground with a fly speed of 5. You may immediately move all target objects up to their speed. While a target is animated by this power, you can move it 5 squares through the air, and i t retains the ability to fly and hover. Effect: The object becomes invisible until the end of your next turn. If you cast this as a melee touch effect, the invisibility instead lasts 10 minutes or until you dismiss it. If the object becomes part of an attack or a similar offensive action, the invisibili ty ends.

Sustain Standard: If the target is within 5 squares of you, the invisibility persists until the end of your next turn. If this was originally cast as melee touch, the target needs to be within 20 squares instead, and it can be sustained for up to an additional 10 minutes.

You or an ally are able to jump great distances for a longer amount of time through a slight manipulation of the spell.

ENCOUNTER / STANDARD

Melee touch

Target: You or one creature

Prerequisite: You have the Jump power (Wizard 2).

Effect: The target can use a move action to jump up to 6 squares or up to its speed, whichever is lower, without having to make an Athletics check. This lasts for up to 1 minute, although it lasts only until the end of the next round if you or the target are in or enter a combat encounter.
